methods.method: Recomputed protocol_g7.json with hashes.overlay_hash=null using canonical sorted compact JSON SHA-256; normalized the single protocol_g7.md Document hash line to SELF_EXCLUDED and SHA-256 hashed LF bytes. Cross-checked g7 supersedes/inheritance declarations against the already reviewed g1-g6 declared hash chain.

Recomputed dataset_manifest.json using the builder's actual pre-insertion method: remove manifest_hash, canonical JSON SHA-256. Cross-checked dataset_receipt rows/shards/hash, checkpoint COMPLETE sealed_shards equality, and source_binding binding-subobject hash.

For each of 34 shards, streamed SHA-256 over compressed bytes, fully decompressed for gzip integrity, compared its .receipt.json object to the manifest entry, and sampled the first and last JSON lines for decision_ms equality to declared first_ms/last_ms. Did not perform a new 4M-row semantic rescan.
Summed manifest-declared shard rows and derived partition extrema from all 34 manifest entries; cross-checked the three chronological partition gaps against g7 purge requirements.
Cross-checked g7 and manifest legacy statuses, sealed reward flags, safety flags, and account_state_fixture_receipt.json status/declared no-real-StateRow/no-reward-label access.

manifest_self_hash.method: manifest_hash absent during hash, matching cmd/data-driven-v3-dataset/main.go

limitations: No new line-by-line semantic scan or independent row recount of 3,996,040 rows was performed; approval is hash-bound to the manifest, all compressed shard bytes, matching shard receipts, gzip integrity, and first/last-line samples.
No reward, PnL, winner, exam, private-raw, or records data was read.
Approval is limited to the preregistered g7 protocol/dataset/account-fixture evidence chain. It does not authorize route execution, label unsealing, exam, shadow, or real-money trading.

hashes.hash_method: Set hashes.receipt_hash to null, then SHA-256 the canonical JSON encoding (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8).
